protocol.strategy: 1D SHORT, flip age=3, D0 LOW exclusion, BULL reflip OPEN exit or max horizon
protocol.age_definition: flip OPEN age=0; entry at flip OPEN+3 calendar days (fourth OPEN including flip)
protocol.selection_rule: Highest TRAIN per-signal PF only, tie -> shortest horizon; diagnostic candidate, not portfolio optimum
protocol.ATR: 14 closed-bar simple mean true range, lagged one OPEN; preserves prior implementation
protocol.threshold_rule: D0 > TRAIN tercile-1; no TRAIN minimum/maximum bounding of future D0
protocol.common_cohort: all horizons use eight future daily OPENs; not legacy 12D/24D support
protocol.purge: TRAIN selection entries plus 8D must precede split OPEN
protocol.gap_policy: split at missing 15m; retain complete UTC days only; reset PSAR and 100D burn-in after gaps
protocol.walk_forward: annual test, preceding two calendar years fit, eight-day maturity purge; fit D0 and choose horizon on past only
protocol.BTC_regime: prior closed BTC close vs close 90 days earlier; >+10% UP, <-10% DOWN, otherwise RANGE; no optimization
protocol.OOS_status: 2025-2026 repeatedly observed before this protocol; historical validation, not pristine OOS
protocol.funding: not included; 20/40/80bp are round-trip fee/slippage assumptions, not measured funding
